props.name: sortable
props._description: Lets the user reorder or sort the list items.

props.name: filterable
props._description: Adds a filter box above the list.

props.name: selectedItemIndex
props._description: Index of the item selected when the list first renders.

props.name: static

content.name: items
content._description: The authored list items used when `static` is true.

props._description: `true` means the items are authored here, in `content`. `false` means they arrive at runtime.

props.name: enableHeaderText

content.name: Header Text
content._description: The caption text shown beside the control.

position.name: Header Position
position._description: Which side of the control the caption sits on: `left`, `top`, `right` or `bottom`.

props._description: Turns on a caption attached to the control. When true, the `_true` sub-props supply the caption text and which side it sits on.
